ticket: CHK-482 — Checkout page. The customer fills in their details, optionally applies a promo code, reviews the order summary, and places the order. All form fields should be left-aligned in a single column, the order total must be readable, and the Place order button should sit below the terms text.

expected.description: The Place order button is positioned on top of the terms text instead of below it, obscuring the terms the customer must agree to.
expected.evidence: The button's bounding box overlaps the terms paragraph's box rather than sitting under it.

expected.description: The order reference overflows its fixed-width container and spills outside the card.
expected.evidence: The text is a single unbroken token wider than the 190px box, and white-space is nowrap.

expected.description: The order total is rendered in white on a white background and is invisible to the customer.
expected.evidence: The Total to pay row has a visible label but no visible amount.

expected.description: The Postcode field is indented relative to every other field in the form, breaking the single-column alignment.
expected.evidence: Its box starts about 34px further right than the Address and Email fields above it.

expected.description: The Apply button for the promo code is pushed outside the right edge of its card.
expected.evidence: The button's right edge extends past the card's right edge.

expected.description: Deliberate test case: a hallucinated element handle that must fall back to the region instead of being dropped.
expected.evidence: Exercises the recovery path for an invalid ref.

expected.description: Deliberate test case: a region-only finding, for when no listed element corresponds to the problem.
